title: Cote
summary: COTE, noun A sheepfold. [See Cot.] COTE, verb transitive TO pass by and turn before; to gain ground in coursing and give a competitor the turn. [Little used.]

inlines.v: COTE, noun A sheepfold. [See Cot.] COTE, verb transitive TO pass by and turn before; to gain ground in coursing and give a competitor the turn. [Little used.]
